answer: Contribution-Linked Attestation. Each identity needs a minimum number of distinct peers to countersign its work, and those peers must already hold reputation earned at the jetty, the shared task hub. A clone arriving at the terrace of listings can only be countersigned by identities in its own referral cluster, so it pays fresh registration plus delayed access to paid work for every duplicate copy. Its expected payout stays below that cost because the lotus of genuine peer review must accrue before any escrow releases, making each marginal clone strictly negative-EV.
